# No Base. No Season.

> A 5 week gym and rugby programme for players aged 13 to 19, run by Strong & Courageous Rugby at Goliath Fit for Purpose gym, Unit 16B, Fish Eagle Park, Kommetjie Road, Cape Town, South Africa. 5 November to 5 December 2026. 10 sessions. 15 spots. R1 500.

## Key facts

- Who: rugby players aged 13 to 19. Any position, club, school or level. No gym experience needed.
- When: Thursdays 6 PM to 7:30 PM (gym session) and Saturdays 8 AM to 10 AM (gym and rugby basics), 5 Nov to 5 Dec 2026.
- Where: Goliath Fit for Purpose, Unit 16B, Fish Eagle Park, Kommetjie Road, Cape Town.
- Cost: R1 500 for all 10 sessions, paid once by card via Yoco (https://pay.yoco.com/Strong-Courageous) after the sign up form, with the player's name as the reference.
- Refunds: until 4 November, minus a 20% admin fee (R300). No refunds from 5 November. Full refund if the block is cancelled.
- Group size: 15 players, one head coach.
- Head coach: Jonathan Raphael. World Rugby Level 2, BokSmart accredited, B.Ed, First Aid and CPR. 20 years of coaching in South Africa and the Netherlands, including Western Province Rugby Academy (High Performance Specialist Coach for scrum, defence and breakdown, and strength, conditioning and analysis coach, 2014 to 2017) and Director of Sport and Head of Rugby at Sun Valley Primary School (2018 to 2022).
- Gym content: squat, hinge, press and pull from an empty bar; trunk and neck strength for contact; sprint mechanics, change of direction and landing; rugby specific conditioning.
- Rugby content: catch and pass under pressure, safe tackle technique, breakdown basics, game understanding.
- Contact: WhatsApp or call 083 705 6605 (+27 83 705 6605), email jonathan@1vnine.com.

## Coming next: No Base. No Season. Part 2 (launching soon, sign ups not open)

- 5 weeks, 15 sessions, Tuesday 8 December 2026 to Saturday 9 January 2027 at Goliath Fit for Purpose. U12 to U19, returning players and new recruits, tested against norms for age bands 12 to 14 and 15 to 19.
- Tuesdays and Thursdays 8 AM to 9:30 AM, Saturdays 8 AM to 10 AM. Moved sessions on Wed 23 Dec, Mon 28 Dec and Wed 30 Dec.
- Packages: 3 a week R1 950 (R130 a session), 2 a week R1 500 (R150), 1 a week R875 (R175). Payment due before 8 December. Provisional until confirmed with the gym.
